title: terraria ghasts
description: replaces the ghast(Spazmatism) and the happy ghast(retinazer) also includes the dried ghast and ghast tears(souls of sight)
body:
replaces the ghast family of mobs and items into the twins from terraria
this includes the ghast, the happy ghast, the ghastling, the dried ghast, the ghast tears,the tears music disc, the (happy)ghast spawn eggs and the firecharge
